about: Background-job tasks run end to end (`bench/jobTasks.mjs`): each starts a job as the texting Worker would, runs its parts through the real gateway in a throwaway world with the done check after each, and grades what it left behind in plain code (the page exists, cites its sources, answers every part of the ask, keeps what it should, the errand's site step happened, the job ended done). A quality judge reads the page only for what code can't. Everything is invented: Maya is the bench's invented person and every site is a scripted one in `bench/ai/sites/`. `covers`: each entry must appear in the page (case-insensitive); `a|b` means either, so a date may be written any way it reads (a range such as `13-15` names its last day too). `keeps`: lines of a placed page that must survive the edit. A case with `target` captures a bug not fixed yet: reported, never blocking.

cases.text: can you make me a page comparing the caterers on caterers.example for my 40 person party? total for 40 for each one, and link each so i can check

job.title: Caterers page for 40
job.brief: Compare every caterer listed on caterers.example for a 40-person party on a page in Maya's notes: the full total for 40 people (food, sides and drinks) for each, with a link to each caterer's page.
job.doneWhen: A page in Maya's notes lists every caterer on caterers.example with its total for 40 people and a link to its page, and Maya has the page's link.

quality: Each total adds food, sides and drinks for 40 people, and Nonna's Trays is priced by trays that serve ten
It says which caterer is cheapest
A reader can scan it: a table or one line per caterer, no filler

cases.text: we need a sunday space for church services in riverside. find halls that are actually free on sundays and put them on a page with the sunday price and a link for each

job.title: Sunday halls page
job.brief: Find event halls in Riverside that are free to rent on Sundays (not ones a church already uses on Sundays) and put them on a page in Maya's notes with each one's Sunday price and a link to its page.
job.doneWhen: A page in Maya's notes lists the Riverside halls available on Sundays, each with its Sunday price (or that it publishes none) and a link, and Maya has the page's link.

quality: Grace Hall and St. Brendan Commons are left out, or named only as not available on Sundays
Ferry House is shown as publishing no price (on request), never given a made-up one
The directory's general price range is never put beside a hall as its price

cases.text: put the lunch spots from lunch.example on a page with what lunch costs at each, and where you got it

job.title: Lunch prices page
job.brief: Put every lunch spot on lunch.example on a page in Maya's notes with its lunch price range and the link the price came from.
job.doneWhen: A page in Maya's notes lists every lunch spot on lunch.example with its lunch prices and a source link for each price, and Maya has the page's link.

quality: Seoul Box's prices come from its ordering page, never a guess or 'no price available'
Each price has the link it came from
